operations.credit_rule_for_next_section: Only concepts with state USABLE may be assumed in S11. PARTIAL, MENTION_ONLY, MISCONCEPTION_RISK and MISSING receive no automatic prerequisite credit.

effective_campaign_state.note_on_counts: Running local counts only. Mandatory global passes may merge recurring root causes, reject false positives or change severity when later dependency evidence is available.

S11_entry_watchlist: S11 is the first canonical OOP/classes section. The custom exception classes shown in S09 and external library objects used in S10 remain non-creditable as class/inheritance knowledge.
The invariant concept remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK from S03/S04 and must be rebuilt before S11 uses class invariants/state validity.
src layout may be treated as USABLE, but module/import/public-API/entrypoint semantics remain PARTIAL or MISCONCEPTION_RISK.
S10 did not repair process-exit semantics: helper return values, printed error labels and actual OS exit status remain distinct and must not be silently assumed.
Configuration precedence/fail-fast remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK because S10 contradicted its own precedence and swallowed fatal validation errors.
stdout/stderr remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK because the canonical S10 stderr demo wrote every line to stdout.
JSON/provenance remain PARTIAL/MISCONCEPTION_RISK from S08; S11 serialization examples need a bridge rather than assuming mastery.
Public API and __all__ remain MISCONCEPTION_RISK; encapsulation in S11 must not inherit the idea that naming conventions or __all__ enforce privacy.
SemVer/package versioning remains PARTIAL and is not a prerequisite for understanding object/domain modeling.
CP-N1-C/CASO identifiers remain a persistent widow-term family unless expanded globally.
